acceptanceCriteria: internal/tasks/cli tests that launch worker process groups register them with the same reaper, or an equivalent.
A test that SIGKILLs the cli test binary leaves no surviving worker group.
body: V1-2189 (PR #1474) added a dead-man reaper in internal/tasks/dispatch TestMain. Tests in internal/tasks/cli that launch dispatch workers are not covered. Two orphaned host.sh workers from TestCALV0143_WorkerLogsAreCappedWhileTheWorkerRuns survived 9-12 h with ppid 1 on 2026-10-21 (killed by hand).
title: internal/tasks/cli dispatch tests can orphan host.sh workers: the dispatch dead-man reaper does not cover them
